name: Dies Entelecheia
overview: Dies Entelecheia is the sixth installment in the Shinza Bansho visual novel/literary series by writer Takashi Masada. Set chronologically in the future of Dies irae and as a prequel to Kajiri Kamui Kagura, the story explores the tragic breakdown of the "Fifth Heaven" (Anima Entelecheia).
